acceptanceCriteria.text: One workflow run reports duration for each material Review Pages stage with monotonic timestamps.
Generation-complete, gh-pages-push-complete and HTTP-visible timestamps are distinguishable.
Queue/runner startup delay is separated where GitHub event/job metadata permits it.
Timing evidence is bounded and contains no PR source body, credentials or raw CI logs.
Existing deterministic review package bytes and publication semantics are unchanged.
Documentation records a current baseline from at least one real non-draft PR run and identifies the dominant latency boundary.
No hard pass/fail SLO is introduced before baseline evidence exists.

issue.title: chore: measure Review Pages generation publication and serving latency
